name: dodge-the-swing-app
description: Android wrapper for Dodge the Swing

scripts.sync: npm run bundle && cap sync android
scripts.apk:
npm run sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21 ./gradlew assembleDebug && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ~/Desktop/DodgeTheSwing.apk && echo '
APK copied to your Desktop as DodgeTheSwing.apk'
